encyclopedia.summary: David Production's 2014 television adaptation of Part 3 of Hirohiko Araki's JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. The Joestar line and their allies travel from Japan to Egypt to destroy the vampire DIO, who woke after a century. Part 3 is where the 'Stand' system is first laid out, and its rules carry the rest of the series.

key_facts.value: Part 3 of Hirohiko Araki's JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

highlights: The Stand rules — range, weakness, reflection — are first set out in this part.
Its travel structure puts a new enemy and a new place in front of the cast every week.
It follows the 1989-1992 manga closely and set the bar for later part adaptations.

encyclopedia.summary: A creature that blew a piece of the moon off becomes homeroom teacher of class 3-E, and the students are given one year to kill him. Lerche made the 2015 TV anime from Yusei Matsui's manga. The premise — assassination drills and career worries happening in the same classroom — is what gives the show its character.
highlights: Teacher and students can kill each other, and lessons still run as lessons — the joke holds for a whole year.
The assassination job keeps colliding with each student's plans after graduation, and the tone shifts with it.
Koro-sensei's identity is settled early; the open question becomes why this class.
